prompt: I have a small folder with 3 messy invoice files: one PDF, one JPG receipt, and one PNG screenshot. Please extract the date, vendor name, invoice number (if any), amount, and a short product/service description from each. Then rename each file exactly using this format: "YYYY-MM-DD Vendor - Invoice - Description.ext" (with the appropriate extension) and organize them into folders by vendor name (e.g., VendorName/). Preserve the original files and place the renamed copies inside the vendor folders. Also create a CSV file named "invoice-summary.csv" in the root folder listing all extracted invoice details with these columns: Date, Vendor, Invoice Number, Description, Amount, File Path. The CSV must include a header row and use commas as separators. Nothing should be moved, only copied for organization. Treat missing invoice numbers as blank in the CSV. Use consistent YYYY-MM-DD date formatting for filenames and CSV. Be sure the filenames avoid special characters except hyphens and spaces as shown. This is a test of basic extraction and organization with three different file types.
